segments.normalizedSource: ```swift class PaintingCanvas { // ... func addPoint(_ position: SIMD3<Float>) { /// The maximum distance between two points before requiring a new point. let threshold: Float = 1E-9 // Start a new stroke if no stroke exists. if currentStroke == nil { currentStroke = Stroke() // Add the stroke to the root. root.addChild(currentStroke!.entity) } // Check if the length between the current hand position and the previous point meets the threshold. if let previousPoint = currentStroke?.points.last, length(position - previousPoint) < threshold { return } // Add the current position to the stroke. currentStroke?.points.append(position) // Update the current stroke mesh. currentStroke?.updateMesh() } func finishStroke() { if let stroke = currentStroke { // Trigger the update mesh operation. stroke.updateMesh() // Clear the current stroke. currentStroke = nil } } } ```
